faqs.question: Is MyEtherWallet free?
faqs.answer: Yes. MyEtherWallet is free and open-source. Network (gas) fees and third-party service fees may apply to transactions.

faqs.question: Does MyEtherWallet hold my funds or keys?
faqs.answer: No. MEW is a self-custody, client-side wallet. Your private keys never leave your device and MEW never has access to your funds.

faqs.question: Which wallets and devices does MEW support?
faqs.answer: MEW supports hardware wallets (Ledger, Trezor), the MEW mobile app, the Enkrypt browser extension, and WalletConnect.

faqs.question: What can I do with MyEtherWallet?
faqs.answer: You can send and receive crypto, swap tokens, buy and sell crypto, stake, trade perpetuals, and access tokenized stocks.

faqs.question: Is MyEtherWallet safe?
faqs.answer: MEW is open-source and client-side, so you retain control of your keys. Always verify you are on the correct URL and never share your private key or recovery phrase.
